edges.reason: Constructor Owned() assigns owner from the caller-controlled msg.sender
msg.sender is written directly into the owner state variable
transfer reads and updates balances[msg.sender] using the caller address
msg.sender is used as the mapping key into balances
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the caller
msg.sender indexes the nested allowed mapping as the owner key
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller as spender
approveAndCall keys allowed with msg.sender and forwards it to receiveApproval
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on require(msg.sender == owner)
onlyOwner modifier gates the privileged transferAnyERC20Token sweep
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner before committing ownership
Constructor assigns the symbol string state variable
Constructor assigns the name string state variable
Constructor assigns decimals = 18
Constructor mints the fixed _totalSupply value
Constructor credits balances[0x2d57365a7ab22425f09D49bB0baFB0426EB8dDF9] with the whole supply
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply
balanceOf returns an entry of the balances mapping
transfer debits and credits entries of the balances mapping
approve writes an entry of the allowed mapping
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to]
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender]
allowance returns a nested entry of the allowed mapping
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable
acceptOwnership reads and clears the newOwner state variable
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with the previously staged newOwner
transferAnyERC20Token sends the recovered tokens to the owner address
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on a caller-supplied spender contract, a state-changing external callback

transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract, mitigated only by the onlyOwner modifier
transfer performs balance arithmetic via SafeMath safeSub/safeAdd which revert on overflow or underflow
transferFrom performs balance and allowance arithmetic via SafeMath safeSub/safeAdd
